# Change-points

## Identify change-points

```{r}
### cpt analysis
ssbcpts <- cpt.mean(data = Herring_full$SSB, method = "BinSeg", Q = 6)
plot(ssbcpts, type = "l", cpt.col = "navyblue", xlab = "Index", pt.widt = 4)
cpts(ssbcpts)
#### Index: 4,    18,   20,   40,   54,   72
#### years: 1950, 1964, 1966, 1986, 2000, 2018

### bcp analysis
bcp.ssb <- bcp(Herring_full$SSB)
plot(bcp.ssb, main = "SSB")
which(bcp.ssb$posterior.prob >= 0.5)
#### Index: 20,   37,   54
#### years: 1966, 1983, 2000

#### Changepoints detected by both methods +-1 year and min. 5 years between points:
#### 1966, 2000
#### Opinion: would include 1986/1983 (looks significant) as only detected by BinSeg
```

## Plot Change-points

```{r}
### Load plotting function from "functions.R"
source("R/functions.R")

### Call function plot_SSB_cpt
plot_SSB_cpt_full <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring_full, 
              changepoints = c(1966, 1986,2000), 
              ribbon_colors = c("steelblue", "orange", "grey", "purple"),
              vline_colors = c("black", "grey", "black"),
              component = "Full Stock", 
              SSB_column = "SSB", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd", 
              show_hlines = TRUE)
plot_SSB_cpt_full
```

### Save plots

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SSB_cpt_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis

## Analysis

```{r}
### Check for time-lags
#SSB_test <- Herring_full[-75,]?
ccf(Herring_full$SSB[-(79:78)], Herring_full$F[-(79:78)], type = "correlation") # 3 years lag

#### Make time-lag object
Herring_full$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring_full$SSB, 3)

### Break-point analysis
bpts <- strucchange::breakpoints(Herring_full$SSB_lag/1000000 ~ Herring_full$F)
plot(bpts)
summary(bpts)

bpts_sum <- summary(bpts)
opt_brks <- opt_bpts(bpts_sum$RSS["BIC",])
opt_brks #### 4
best_brk <- Herring_full$F[bpts2$breakpoints]
best_brk
####  0.28 1.09 0.28 0.189
best_brk_years <- Herring_full$year[bpts2$breakpoints]
best_brk_years
#### 1957, 1968, 1983, 1997

par(mfrow = c(1,1))
ci_mod <- confint(bpts, breaks = opt_brks)
plot(Herring_full$SSB_lag/1000000 ~ Herring_full$F, type = "p")
for (i in 1: opt_brks) {
  abline(v = Herring_full$F[ci_mod$confint[i,2]], col = "blue")
  abline(v = Herring_full$F[ci_mod$confint[i,1]], col = "red", lty = 3)
  abline(v = Herring_full$F[ci_mod$confint[i,3]], col = "red", lty = 3)
}
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call function plot_hysteresis
plot_hysteresis_full <- plot_hysteresis(Herring_full, best_brk_years, "Full Stock")
plot_hysteresis_full
```

### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "hysteresis_full.png"),
       plot = plot_hysteresis_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# SRR Non-Stationary

## Analysis

```{r}
### Run model comparison from model_comp_functions.R 
source("R/model_comp_functions.R")

SSR_analysis <- run_srr_analysis(
    data_for_srr = Herring_full[-(79:78),],
   recruit_col = "R",
   ssb_col = "SSB",
   opt_brks_val = 4)

print(SSR_analysis$comparison_table)

#### strucchange model shows lowest RMSE

#### Strucchange breakpoint analysis
bpts_SRR <- strucchange :: breakpoints(R ~ SSB, data = Herring_full)
bpts_SRR_sum <- summary(bpts_SRR)
opt_brks_SRR <- opt_bpts(bpts_SRR_sum$RSS["BIC",])
opt_brks_SRR #2
bpts2_SRR <-strucchange :: breakpoints(bpts_SRR, breaks = opt_brks_SRR)

best_brk_SRR <- Herring_full$SSB[bpts2_SRR$breakpoints]
best_brk_SRR
#### 264793.8,  2391903.7
best_brk_years_SRR <- Herring_full$year[bpts2_SRR$breakpoints]
best_brk_years_SRR
#### 1981,      2002
```

## Plotting

```{r}
plot_SRR_full <- plot_SRR(Herring_full, best_brk_years_SRR, "Full Stock", "strucchange")
plot_SRR_full
```

#### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SRR_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SRR_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```
